episodes.title: Why Smart People Join Political Cults | Keri Smith on Wokeness and Conspiracies
episodes.description:
Former social justice warrior Keri Smith joins the Chicks on the Right to discuss her journey out of the woke movement, why ideological movements begin to resemble cults, and what finally changed her mind.

The conversation dives into the psychology of political radicalization, social media echo chambers, Charlie Kirk's murder, Candace Owens' growing online movement, the dangers of conspiracy thinking, and why so many people struggle to leave ideological communities once they've become part of their identity.

The episode also tackles the Tate brothers' latest legal troubles, influencer culture, and how internet personalities can build audiences through outrage and division.

Topics include:

Escaping woke ideology
Why political movements become cults
Charlie Kirk's murder and public reaction
Candace Owens' influence online
Social media radicalization
Israel and conspiracy communities
Tate brothers' arrest
Modern conservative media
Faith, identity, and finding purpose
